It scores a high 9.3 on Booking, with guests praising the service, breakfast, comfortable beds and the pool view. One note: the MRT is a 10-15 minute walk away, though the hotel runs a shuttle to the metro line. A fit for couples or anyone who wants a 4-star room with a rooftop pool in this district.

The Asok–Nana part of Sukhumvit (Soi 1–23) sits right at the junction of the BTS Asok and MRT Sukhumvit lines, which is why so many travellers base themselves here. Malls, restaurants, and bars at every price point are all on your doorstep.

The Asok–Nana stretch of Sukhumvit is the easiest base in Bangkok, sitting right where the BTS Asok and MRT Sukhumvit lines meet. Terminal 21 mall, food from every country, and the Soi 11 and Nana nightlife are all within walking distance. Great for first-timers and night owls. Rates run from about ฿800 to several thousand for the 5-star towers.
